title: SG-6.1 Data-driven NPC support from scene data
summary: Scene data alone can add NPCs with placement, manifest animations and optional interaction, and BootScene spawns and animates them.
description: Context: characterSchema (game/src/content/schema.ts) already holds id, name, position, scale, layer and idle/walk/interact animation refs. BootScene.createCharacter already spawns and animates sprites from scene.characters. Desired behavior: a scene author can add any NPC, with optional dialogue or interaction, in scene YAML only. Dangling character references are caught by validation, and clicking an NPC reports its interaction to React, with no code change. Why: future AI cycles must add characters without touching the engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene YAML character with an interaction block, When parseWorldContent('scene') runs, Then it validates and keeps the interaction data.
Given a scene character whose id is not in world.characters, or whose interaction names an unknown dialogue, When validateWorld runs, Then it returns a descriptive error.
Given a scene with several characters, When BootScene.create runs, Then one sprite is created per character at its position and each plays its idle animation.
Given a character with an interaction, When its sprite is clicked, Then a characterClick event with its id and dialogue id is emitted.

preserve: Existing boy character behavior and animation resolution

technical_constraints: Zod schemas stay the single source of content validation
Engine code must stay free of hardcoded character ids
definition_of_done: All requirements have Act and Verify units complete
Unit tests for the three slices pass
